value.rationale: PASS: finite-rank rigidity is a natural, independently recognized Fock Toeplitz problem (Bauer--Le 2011; Borichev--Rozenblum 2013). This new entire-kernel theorem rules out *every* positive finite rank for an all-length class of unbounded products, strengthening the 2026 zero-product theorem and isolating joint exponential type as the precise structural mechanism. It is neither a fixed-parameter table entry nor a restatement of operator nonvanishing.
